text: Read rheology/20261118-3 and -6 (clones at v20 and v23: 137 and 156 calls, clone gates PASS at 2f447e8 and 0e9aeb4, nothing written outside) and -5 and -8 (rheotool-0001 alone; -8 ran series_settled, series_maximum, measurement_error and planar_poiseuille_oldroyd_b_profile through the runner). All four may be wiped. rheotool-24 is landed: test-outside-the-repository says that what a session says of its own model or effort is not evidence, and that the collection reads both from its command line. rheotool-8: the root line binds the repository's general machinery, not what a request builds; a blind clone misread it, so this seat will put a clarifying wording to the person rather than change the rule itself.
